text:
liam: Heads-up: embeddings in eu-west1 started showing increased GC pressure around 22:58 UTC. error spike ~3.6%. suspect kvcache fragmentation under long-prefix reuse. proposing a small hotfix + phased traffic shift to eu-west2 during the 23:30-00:00 UTC change window.
deploy-bot: Deploy request DR-2026-489 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.2.1-patch. rollout plan: 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%.
maya: prefer conservative cadence: 3% for 6m, 15% for 7m, 50% for 6m, then full if metrics stable. pin previous image v3.2.0 for instant rollback.
tara: quick perf note: eu-west2 infra perf stable in canary lab runs, mem churn down ~25%, p95 stable.
liam: rollback triggers: immediate rollback to v3.2.0 if errors > 1% OR p95 increases >150ms sustained 2m OR any OOMs. ops-bot: rollback policy recorded.
ivan: need expedited infra lead ok; paging @rana and @oliver. who can sign?
maya: i'll approve from platform. release notes draft: "embeddings: mitigate kvcache fragmentation leading to transient OOMs under heavy prefix reuse. no model changes." link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-2026-489/notes
releasebot: Release note attached to DR-2026-489. changelog entry: "v3.2.1-patch — kvcache fragmentation mitigation"
ivan: ok for approvals, but please add a temporary safety-net: a 10-minute monitoring hold after completion and a rollback shortcut in the deployctl notes.
liam: agreed. ops-runbook snippet: 
```
# start phased shift to eu-west2
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.1-patch --percent 3 --note "phased-hotfix-DR-2026-489"
# ramp steps handled via deployctl schedule
# immediate rollback
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.0
```
tara: commands look good. i'll monitor traces and heap profiles.
ivan: ops-bot please create temporary alerts: p95>150ms OR errors>1% OR any OOM on embeddings-eu-west2, escalate to oncall -> infra-lead.
ops-bot: Temporary alert ALRT-8001 created. escalation chain: oncall -> infra-lead.
ivan: infra lead @rana approved via DM and asked for 3%@6m, 15%@7m cadence. rana: approved (DM).
maya: ops-bot schedule deploy at 23:30 UTC. all operators: liam, tara, maya, ivan.
ops-bot: Scheduled: DR-2026-489 will start at 23:30 UTC. Operators on rotation: liam, tara, maya, ivan.
liam: post-deploy checklist: verify canary success, kv cache hit ratio, p95, heap fragmentation metrics, and error budget. i'll give final sign-off at 23:55 if healthy.
tara: if any segfaults/OOMs, immediate rollback. otherwise proceed with ramp. :white_check_mark:
maya: i'll post release note to #release-notes after cutoff.
releasebot: Posted: "Embeddings v3.2.1-patch — kvcache fragmentation mitigation" https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-489
ivan: good to go. thanks team.
liam: closing thread; will report final status after 10m safety hold. :hourglass:
